Step-6 reader-1 audit is complete. Full results are in [frontier-11-reader-1.findings.md](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-11-reader-1.findings.md).

Key outcomes:

- Read all 38 assigned items, four pages, every proof step, and all 98 distinct direct dependencies.
- Fixed nine fatal and four nonfatal defects.
- Built the missing [Koch nonrectifiability counterexample](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/cex-the-koch-curve-is-not-rectifiable.md). Lower semicontinuity alone was confirmed to be vacuous; the proof instead uses persistent partitions. This agrees with the construction described in [Ghomi’s lecture notes](https://ghomi.math.gatech.edu/Classes/Math497C/LectureNotes1.pdf).
- Verified that Hausdorff dimension and the Schwarz lantern lack specific prerequisite machinery and recorded dispositions.
- Verified Apostol Definition 6.16 and Theorems 6.17–6.20 against an accessible [full-text copy](https://studylib.net/doc/27468305/mathematical-analysis-by-tom-a.-apostol--z-lib.org-); all locators are accurate.
- Prominently recorded the claim-changing repair to [the sparse-spikes example](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/ex-sparse-spikes-ftc-conclusion-at-a-discontinuity.md).
- All 13 changed/new items pass precheck, citecheck, prosecheck, and rendercheck.

The report identifies the required later reconciliation of the frozen batch contracts and plan artifacts. The only global depcheck failures are the four known out-of-batch protected complex-number items.
